frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

native_facts: Horns575, paired grooved bone natural equipment on Head288/0. Native data does not specify skull coordinates.
user_interpretation: Symmetric sheep/ram-like grooved horns; preserve this selected interpretation rather than replace it with straight spikes.
root: Full roots start inside the skull at X+/-45,Y151,Z20, radius17. Initial stem grows upward/outward through the upper lateral crown; original head occludes the buried portion. Actual visual emergence must be reviewed, not assumed from proxy depth.
curl: Compact thick ram curl: rise outward from crown, sweep backward then downward around lateral skull, return forward and upward to a short tapered point. X, Y and Z vary independently. Posterior broad sweep can hide the anterior short return in north; south shows that return in front of the back sweep. No threadlike second spiral. Forward short return moves inward beside the skull and is hidden by skull/sweep from behind where depth requires.

skull_proxy.meaning: Authored ellipsoid fitted to existing S/E/N head contours, not native skull coordinates. Used for item/body depth only; original head pixels remain authoritative.

projection.registration: Y uses the same125 reference; E/N add18/16px to match unchanged source head landmarks. Common physical scale; no per-facing bounds fit.

views.south: Anterior emerging roots visible at upper lateral crown; short forward return crosses in front of posterior descending sweep. Coil stays mainly beside the skull. Original flesh ears remain separate.
views.east: Full compact loop rises from upper lateral crown, sweeps screen-left/back, drops around lateral skull then turns forward/up into a short point above the ear. Far horn may be hidden. Buried root has no exposed cap.
views.north: Anterior root interiors are behind skull. Posterior broad descending sweep is nearest and hides the overlapping forward return; no copied frontal tip laid over the back sweep. Visible root exit must join crown without a floating end.
views.west: Mirror east geometry and depth for symmetric Head288/0 item; no source/body scale or binding change.

gates: Check complete manual views and root/return closeups before refinement.
Fresh independent review after each contextual refinement, before extraction or fitting.
Numerical clearance is diagnostic; visible attachment and flow must also pass.
